messages:
ashley_cs: FYI — onboarding SSO flows for ~40 EU tenants are returning 401 after our token rotation at 02:17 UTC. We've flagged a regression. Need a short CS status for affected customers and concrete mitigation steps. /cc @michael_csm @raghav_se
raghav_se: Investigating. Initial logs show refresh token TTL wasn't updated by the rotation job for legacy sessions. Rolling back token-rotation job now.
deploy-bot: deployment rollback started: token-rotate-v2 -> token-rotate-v1. Rollback ETA ~8m.
michael_csm: Can we get a list of affected tenants and renewal-risk score? I'll prioritize outreach for renewals that may be impacted.
olivia_support: Got list from incidents page — 42 tenants (mostly EU). Adding renewal_score and ARR to spreadsheet now, flagging 10 high-risk renewals.
ashley_cs: Drafting customer email. Keep it short, empathic, action-first. Posting sample below — quick thumbs?
ashley_cs: ```Subject: SSO sign-in issue — temporary workaround and next steps

Hi {Name},

We detected an SSO sign-in error (401) affecting a subset of EU onboarding flows after a routine token rotation. We're rolling back the rotation and working to restore sign-ins.

What you can try right now:
• Re-initiate SSO sign-in from your app (sign out → sign in).
• If you urgently need API access, create a temporary API key: Settings → API keys.

We’ve scheduled a live troubleshooting session for impacted customers — details below. We’ll follow up with a full RCA. Apologies for the disruption — we’re prioritizing your access.

Best,
The Redwood CS Team
```
emily_prod: LGTM. Add a one-line link to the public status page (so customers can self-check): https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1738001234
raghav_se: Root cause: rotation job didn't migrate legacy session TTLs; patch committed and will be live once rollback finishes. RCA doc to follow with timeline and fix plan.
michael_csm: CS action plan (we should all align):
1) Send targeted email to the 42 affected tenants within 1 hour.
2) Schedule two office-hours: EMEA morning + EMEA/APAC overlap for customers.
3) Offer a goodwill credit for impacted renewal accounts (apply case-by-case).
4) For top-10 renewals, schedule 1:1 calls.
5) Log every reply into the CS triage doc for follow-up.
ashley_cs: Proposed office hours: Wed 09:30 CET (08:30 UTC) and Thu 16:00 SGT (08:00 UTC). I'll create calendar invites and include engineering and support.
olivia_support: Publishing a short status note on the status page and adding affected tenant list (tenant IDs only). Will pin to the customer workspace and DM flagged AMs.
ashley_cs: Also adding a short customer feedback capture (one-question form) so we can quantify impact: https://forms.redwood.ai/sso-impact
michael_csm: :thumbsup: I'll draft a renewal-facing note for AMs to send to flagged accounts with the credit offer template.
raghav_se: Will post a "service restored" update when rollback completes and attach the RCA summary. Also adding a canary test and rotation dry-run to CI to prevent recurrence.
deploy-bot: rollback complete. token-rotate-v1 restored at 02:24 UTC.
ashley_cs: Thanks — sending emails now. Will paste final copy + send time in this thread.
ashley_cs: (update) Emails sent to all 42 affected tenants at 02:35 UTC. Office-hour invites created. CS triage doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/cs/1738001234-triage
michael_csm: Doing outreach for top-10 now, will post summaries in the triage doc. Please tag me on any replies that look like renewal risk.
raghav_se: RCA draft uploaded: https://docs.redwood.ai/rca/1738001234. Main corrective actions: restore rotation behavior for legacy sessions, add integration test, add canary before rotation, improve alerting on token expirations.
ashley_cs: Closing loop for customers: we’ll provide status updates every 4 hours until 24h stability window completed, then move to daily updates for one week. I’ll post the next 4-hour update at 06:35 UTC.
support-bot: Incident 1738001234: status updates scheduled; reminder set for 4-hour cadence.
michael_csm: Thanks team — solid response. Please log any customer credit approvals in the triage doc so finance can reconcile.
ashley_cs: Will do. Filing this thread into the incident folder and prepping a short customer-facing RCA for tomorrow.
